summary: The US (43% of all courses), Scotland, England, Canada, Australia and Japan come fast; South Korea, Sweden and France are the finds, and China (#11), Spain, Ireland and South Africa are the near misses.
reasons: Builder's own replays, pending a real judge (the builder knew the answers when writing them). A casual order found 7 and lost its lives on Ireland, Spain, South Africa, China and Mexico.

The R&A's 2019 count (Golf course article), top 20 only: countries below it cost a life with no figure (noFigures). England and Scotland count on their own as golf counts them, the prompt says so, and 'uk' offers the two. Wales and Northern Ireland are in no count: free.
Not the bank's 'countries with the most <sport> wins' pattern: it counts courses, which players reason out from wealth, space and golf culture. Never a Blitz (20 figures).
